requirement: The cooling system shall maintain available cooling capacity equal to or greater than defined critical cooling demand during required operating periods
architecture_element: Chillers pumps controls and capacity-state logic

requirement: The system shall provide continuous visibility of redundancy state and cooling capacity margin
acceptance_criterion: Redundancy state and capacity margin available for each 15-minute performance interval

requirement: The maintenance process shall achieve preventive maintenance compliance >= 95 percent
The cooling plant shall achieve weighted COP >= 3.30 over the post demonstration period
architecture_element: VFD controls instrumentation and plant optimization

requirement: The facility shall achieve modeled PUE <= 1.50 over the post demonstration period within the declared energy boundary
architecture_element: Energy metering and facility energy model

requirement: Critical monitoring channels shall have a nominal sampling interval of 60 seconds with daily completeness >= 95 percent
Control supervisory and analytics functions shall implement defined logical separation and least-privilege access
